author: blu
body: Pages is a string ARRAY. The generator had it as a single string split on commas, which the shipped script has never done and which would have broken any caller passing more than one page the documented way.

author: blu
body: The colours are the BRIGHT variants because PowerShell's ConsoleColor names sit one intensity below the ANSI ones: what the shipped script wrote as Cyan is ClBrightCyan here, and ClCyan would emit DarkCyan and change what the terminal shows.

author: blu
body: These three files are served alongside the page rather than compiled into it: the stylesheet and card renderer are shared across every page, and the auth bootstrap has to run after the compiled script has defined ensureAccount, which is why it is appended to the body and not the head.
